dialogues.jp: つつがなく授業が終わる。

dialogues.en:
Even though we had Math and Physics today, Sakura wasn't
allowed to teach them.
dialogues.text:
Even though we had Math and Physics today, Sakura wasn't
allowed to teach them.

dialogues.jp:
今日も数学や物理はあったのだが、さくらは授
業をやらせてもらえないらしい。
dialogues.en:
She showed up in the homeroom after the class, but after she
did the administrative stuff, she left the room with a sad
smile on her face.
dialogues.text:
She showed up in the homeroom after the class, but after she
did the administrative stuff, she left the room with a sad
smile on her face.

dialogues.jp:
帰りのホームルームには現れたが、事務的に片
付けて、俺に少しだけ笑顔を浮かべて去ってし
まった。
dialogues.en:
I wonder if she was alone in the staff room in the
afternoon.
dialogues.text:
I wonder if she was alone in the staff room in the
afternoon.

dialogues.jp:
午後の時間は、また職員室で一人ぼっちだった
のだろうか。
dialogues.en:
When I think about that, I can't sit still, but I don't want
to spoil her, either.
dialogues.text:
When I think about that, I can't sit still, but I don't want
to spoil her, either.

dialogues.jp:
そう考えると、いてもたってもいられないのだ
が、甘やかすこともしたくはない。
dialogues.en:
If her dream is being a teacher, she should get over it by
herself.
dialogues.text:
If her dream is being a teacher, she should get over it by
herself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君って結構シビアだよね」
dialogues.en: "You're a quite strict guy, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're a quite strict guy, aren't you?"

dialogues.jp:
帽子を整えながら、ことりが上品に微笑んでい
た。
dialogues.en: Kotori is smiling elegantly while fixing her hat.
dialogues.text: Kotori is smiling elegantly while fixing her hat.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、なんでもないの。珍しい顔してたなって」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing. I said you looked a little different."
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing. I said you looked a little different."

dialogues.jp: ぐーっと机に寝そべる。
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「くすくす……別に照れなくてもいいのに」
dialogues.en: "You looked kinda cool, though."
dialogues.text: "You looked kinda cool, though."

dialogues.jp:
椅子を足で押しながら立ち上がり、そのまま机
に座る。
dialogues.en: "Come on, stop that nonsense..."
dialogues.text: "Come on, stop that nonsense..."

dialogues.jp: 「杉並は？」
dialogues.en: I lean on the desk.
dialogues.text: I lean on the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なんか学園のデータを見てるのが楽しすぎ
　るらしくて、私に代返頼む、って引きこもっ
　ちゃった」
dialogues.en: "Heehee... You don't need to be embarrassed."
dialogues.text: "Heehee... You don't need to be embarrassed."

dialogues.jp:
あいつ、ちゃんとさくらのこと調べてるんだろ
うな。
dialogues.en: "Who wouldn't feel embarrassed when you say it like that?"
dialogues.text: "Who wouldn't feel embarrassed when you say it like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そぅ、朝倉くんにも教えておくことがひとつ
　だけあるの……その、変な話」
dialogues.en:
"Really? I think Nemu-chan does an even better job on that
score."
dialogues.text:
"Really? I think Nemu-chan does an even better job on that
score."

dialogues.jp: 人差し指を立ててことりが顔を寄せてくる。
dialogues.en: "Is that 'better', or 'worse'?"
dialogues.text: "Is that 'better', or 'worse'?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あのね……芳乃先生を辞めさせるって話、な
　くなっちゃった」
dialogues.en: "A girl's smile is measured by how attractive it is."
dialogues.text: "A girl's smile is measured by how attractive it is."

dialogues.jp:
唐突過ぎて、本来なら喜ばしい話なのに呆然と
してしまう。
dialogues.en: "Good to know..."
dialogues.text: "Good to know..."

dialogues.jp:
両手を合わせて、ことりが鞄を持って出て行っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: I stand up while pushing the chair out, and sit on the desk.
dialogues.text: I stand up while pushing the chair out, and sit on the desk.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？　――あ」
dialogues.en: "Where's Suginami?"
dialogues.text: "Where's Suginami?"

dialogues.jp: ポケットの中の携帯が震える。
dialogues.en:
I haven't seen him since this afternoon. I know he must have
met Kotori for the meeting at lunch recess.
dialogues.text:
I haven't seen him since this afternoon. I know he must have
met Kotori for the meeting at lunch recess.

dialogues.jp:
もやもやと何一つ気持ちよくなれない気分のま
ま、携帯を取り出す。
dialogues.en:
"He said he's been having so much fun taking a look at the
school database, and went inside after he asked me to answer
the roll for him."
dialogues.text:
"He said he's been having so much fun taking a look at the
school database, and went inside after he asked me to answer
the roll for him."

dialogues.jp: 「メールか……。杉並？」
dialogues.en: "What an idiot to ask you to answer the roll for him..."
dialogues.text: "What an idiot to ask you to answer the roll for him..."

dialogues.jp:
小さな液晶には、杉並の名前とメール着信の表
示があった。
dialogues.en: I hope he's checking the information about Sakura in there.
dialogues.text: I hope he's checking the information about Sakura in there.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ、なにやってんだ……」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I've one thing I've to tell you, Asakura-kun... It's a
kind of weird story, but..."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I've one thing I've to tell you, Asakura-kun... It's a
kind of weird story, but..."

dialogues.jp: 開いたメールには、一言。
dialogues.en:
Putting her index finger up, Kotori brings her face closer
to me.
dialogues.text:
Putting her index finger up, Kotori brings her face closer
to me.

dialogues.jp: 『今日は、天気がいいな』
dialogues.en:
"Listen... They're not talking about firing Yoshino-sensei
any more."
dialogues.text:
"Listen... They're not talking about firing Yoshino-sensei
any more."

dialogues.jp: とだけ書かれていた。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
「バカバカしい！　データの閲覧ってやつは、
　そんなに楽しいのか？」
dialogues.en:
That's totally out of the blue. I feel dumbfounded at this
happy news.
dialogues.text:
That's totally out of the blue. I feel dumbfounded at this
happy news.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、返事などするはずもなく、携帯を仕舞う。
dialogues.en:
"Well, those people who wanted to get rid of Sakura-sensei
had accidents. Umm... I will tell you more after I find out
a bit more."
dialogues.text:
"Well, those people who wanted to get rid of Sakura-sensei
had accidents. Umm... I will tell you more after I find out
a bit more."

dialogues.jp:
席を立ち、カバンを手にする。ことりも頑張っ
ているんだから、俺も頑張らなきゃ。
dialogues.en: "Wait a second, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Wait a second, Kotori."

dialogues.jp: ──ぶるる
dialogues.en: "Sorry, but I don't have any evidence yet to confirm."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but I don't have any evidence yet to confirm."

dialogues.jp: 「……また、メール？」
dialogues.en:
Picking up her bag with her hands close together, Kotori
leaves the room.
dialogues.text:
Picking up her bag with her hands close together, Kotori
leaves the room.

dialogues.jp: しかも、また杉並だった。
dialogues.en: "What's that? Uhh..."
dialogues.text: "What's that? Uhh..."

dialogues.jp: 『お前、俺のこと好きか？』
dialogues.en:
Walking with other students on their way home, Suginami
comes in the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Walking with other students on their way home, Suginami
comes in the classroom.

dialogues.en: "Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Suginami."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、『いっぺん死んで来い』とでも返事
を打とうとした矢先に、続けてメール着信が入
る。
もちろん、杉並だった。
dialogues.en: "Hey?"
dialogues.text: "Hey?"

dialogues.jp: 『朝倉、お前は魔法って信じるか？』
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure if he heard me or not, but he sits on the chair
right in front of me and stares at the blackboard.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure if he heard me or not, but he sits on the chair
right in front of me and stares at the blackboard.

dialogues.jp:
くだらない質問だと思った。ただの｛ざ／戯｝れ言のよ
うな（その前のメールを考えれば、あからさま
に戯れ言なのだが）
dialogues.en: "Oh? I didn't realize that class was already over."
dialogues.text: "Oh? I didn't realize that class was already over."

dialogues.jp: その一文が、妙に引っかかった。
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp:
きゅうっと胸が締め付けられる──というより
心臓を鷲づかみにされる感覚。
dialogues.en: I give him a karate-chop on the back of his head.
dialogues.text: I give him a karate-chop on the back of his head.

dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、あいつめ……一体何をやってやがる」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, Asakura. I guess you finally mastered the instant
movement."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, Asakura. I guess you finally mastered the instant
movement."

dialogues.jp: 着信から、メニューを開いて、電話をかける。
dialogues.en: "Your brains are just tripped out, that's it."
dialogues.text: "Your brains are just tripped out, that's it."

dialogues.jp: ワンコールもしないまま、電話は通じた。
dialogues.en:
He'll realize it when he looks at the students going home or
the chime in the hallway.
dialogues.text:
He'll realize it when he looks at the students going home or
the chime in the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
「おいっ、杉並！　なんだ、このメールは！
　お前、なにしてる！」
しかし、杉並からは返事はなかった。
dialogues.en: "Hey, Suginami? Why are you so quiet?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Suginami? Why are you so quiet?"

dialogues.jp: 「返事しろよ、コラ！　ふざけてんじゃねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, yeah... I have a question for you."
dialogues.text: "Uhh, yeah... I have a question for you."

dialogues.jp:
やはり、電話はつながっただけで、返事もなに
もない。
dialogues.en:
After getting up from the chair, Suginami stands at the
front of the class.
dialogues.text:
After getting up from the chair, Suginami stands at the
front of the class.

dialogues.en: I realize there are only Suginami and me in the room.
dialogues.text: I realize there are only Suginami and me in the room.

dialogues.en: "Do you believe in magic powers?"
dialogues.text: "Do you believe in magic powers?"

dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、勝手にやってろ」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: ──ピッ
dialogues.en: It was another unexpected question.
dialogues.text: It was another unexpected question.

dialogues.jp: さすがに付き合ってられない。俺は通信を切る。
dialogues.en: What's going on with Kotori and Suginami today?
dialogues.text: What's going on with Kotori and Suginami today?

dialogues.jp: しかし、さっきの一文──。
dialogues.en: "Well, never mind..."
dialogues.text: "Well, never mind..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、もう一度、さっきのメールを開いた。
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: 『朝倉、お前は魔法って信じるか？』
dialogues.en:
He finished his comment halfway through, and I feel
dumbfounded again, just like when he came in.
dialogues.text:
He finished his comment halfway through, and I feel
dumbfounded again, just like when he came in.

dialogues.jp:
ことりといい、杉並といい、いったい今日はな
んなのだろう？
「……わけが分からん」
dialogues.en: I give a sigh, scratching my head.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh, scratching my head.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、探偵映画よろしく、ばりばりと髪の毛を
かき回した。
dialogues.en: "I have no idea what's going on."
dialogues.text: "I have no idea what's going on."

dialogues.jp: ◆変化の兆し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Foreboding change◆
dialogues.text: ◆Foreboding change◆

dialogues.jp:
不思議な話だが、さくらを講師から辞めさせよ
うとしていた人達が、皆して事故にあってしまっ
たという。
dialogues.en:
Strangely, all the people who wanted to kick Sakura out of
her teaching position had accidents.
dialogues.text:
Strangely, all the people who wanted to kick Sakura out of
her teaching position had accidents.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は「魔法を信じるか？」なんて訳のわから
ないメールを送ってくるし、
dialogues.en:
Even Suginami asked if I believe in magic powers, which made
me wonder if something awful was about to happen.
dialogues.text:
Even Suginami asked if I believe in magic powers, which made
me wonder if something awful was about to happen.

dialogues.jp:
さすがの俺も、なにかおかしなことが起こり始
めているのを感じた。
dialogues.en: The class finishes without any mishaps.
dialogues.text: The class finishes without any mishaps.
